scripts.validate:plugins: bun --eval "const context = { client: {} }; for (const path of ['./plugins/background-tasks/index.ts', './plugins/zellij/index.ts', './plugins/command-run/index.ts', './plugins/adhd/index.ts']) { const plugin = (await import(path)).default; const hooks = await plugin(context); if (!hooks?.tool) throw new Error(path + ' did not initialize tools'); } const archetypes = (await import('./plugins/agent-archetype-system/index.ts')).default; const hooks = await archetypes(context); const config = {}; await hooks.config(config); for (const id of ['cortex', 'flux', 'zen']) if (config.agent?.[id]?.mode !== 'all') throw new Error(id + ' is not primary-selectable'); const project = await Bun.file('./.opencode/opencode.json').json(); if (project.default_agent !== 'cortex') throw new Error('cortex is not the default agent'); const policy = (await import('./plugins/ae2e/index.ts')).default; const policyHooks = await policy(context); if (typeof policyHooks?.event !== 'function') throw new Error('ae2e did not claim the event hook'); if (typeof policyHooks?.['chat.message'] !== 'function') throw new Error('ae2e did not claim chat.message'); if (policyHooks.tool) throw new Error('ae2e must not offer a tool'); if (policyHooks.config) throw new Error('ae2e must not alter config'); for (const path of ['./.opencode/plugins/background-tasks.ts', './.opencode/plugins/zellij.ts', './.opencode/plugins/command-run.ts', './.opencode/plugins/adhd.ts', './.opencode/plugins/agent-archetype-system.ts', './.opencode/plugins/ae2e.ts']) await import(path);"
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run validate:plugins
